title: std::unordered_multimap<Key,T,Hash,KeyEqual,Allocator>::~unordered_multimap
summary: A destructor. Destructs the unordered_multimap. The destructors of the elements are called and the used storage is deallocated.
html:
~unordered_multimap();
 (since C++11)

A destructor. Destructs the unordered_multimap. The destructors of the elements are called and the used storage is deallocated. Note, that if the elements are pointers, the pointed-to objects are not destroyed.

Complexity

Linear in the size of the unordered_multimap.
